backboard_bottom.value: flat underside rests directly on the desktop; no separate front platform or foot

full_width_groove.value: Side-to-side open insertion groove intended to receive the lower edge of an iPad.

groove_section.value: Flat-bottom insertion channel with parallel rearward-inclined sidewalls.

ipad_inclination.value: iPad must sit at an angle when inserted, not vertically.

ipad_slot_edge_treatment.value: No chamfers or fillets on the iPad insertion structure, including mouth, side openings, walls and floor transitions.

lowered_end_platform.value: Remove the separate rounded rectangular pocket; lower the entire marked end area of the narrow rear platform, with the same depth and length as the former pocket.

lowered_end_platform_extent.value: At negative-X end, open to end and rear edge, spans the whole rear strip up to the iPad channel; nominal strip width 32 mm.
